analyzed_vuln.description: The function-JIT implementation of ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM emits incorrect ownership/refcount handling for the value assigned through an object dimension. In this PoV, assignment into SplFixedArray leaves the object stored in the element/reference without a corresponding owning object reference. The later crash in zend_gc_delref is only the consequence: exception unwinding destroys the direct SplFixedArray CV first, freeing the object, and then destroys the zend_reference whose value still points at that freed object.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Execute the supplied function with opcache JIT mode `function`. The relevant data flow creates `new SplFixedArray(1)` in `$b`, assigns an object-valued/aliased `$a` through `$b[0] = $a`, then creates a reference to that element with `$g = &$b[0]`. The surrounding generated operations arrange for `$a` to alias the SplFixedArray object and eventually raise an uncaught exception. On CV cleanup, `$b` releases the under-counted object before `$g` is destroyed; zend_reference_destroy then decrements the already-freed object and ASan reports the UAF. This requires the JITted ASSIGN_DIM object path plus an object value retained through a referenced SplFixedArray element and exception/function-exit cleanup; the non-JIT warm-up does not produce the corrupt ownership state.

--- a/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit.c
+++ b/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit.c
@@ -63,7 +63,13 @@
 #ifdef ZEND_JIT_USE_RC_INFERENCE
 # define ZEND_SSA_RC_INFERENCE_FLAG ZEND_SSA_RC_INFERENCE
 # define RC_MAY_BE_1(info)          (((info) & (MAY_BE_RC1|MAY_BE_REF)) != 0)
-# define RC_MAY_BE_N(info)          (((info) & (MAY_BE_RCN|MAY_BE_REF)) != 0)
+/*
+ * Calls to user-defined object handlers may retain a value and thereby turn
+ * an inferred RC1 value into RCN.  Always check the decremented refcount
+ * before destroying a JIT operand, rather than relying on refcount inference
+ * that may predate such a call.
+ */
+# define RC_MAY_BE_N(info)          1
 #else
 # define ZEND_SSA_RC_INFERENCE_FLAG 0
 # define RC_MAY_BE_1(info)          1

args: Analyze the ownership/refcount bug in zend_jit_assign_dim in php-src/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit_x86.dasc, specifically the object-dimension path for ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM. Compare its emitted handling of the assigned value with interpreter semantics and analogous JIT assignment functions. Identify the exact incorrect branch/instruction and recommend a root-cause patch.

The supplied ASan reproducer runs under the function-JIT harness and creates SplFixedArray(1), performs $b[0] = $a where $a aliases an object, then $g = &$b[0], and exits through an exception. ASan later reports UAF in zend_reference_destroy because the object retained by the referenced element lacks an owning refcount. The vulnerability report explicitly attributes this to incorrect ownership/refcount emission in zend_jit_assign_dim in php-src/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit_x86.dasc. I need to understand whether the object handler call consumes a copied zval, whether a missing Z_TRY_ADDREF is involved, and how array/object paths differ before applying a minimal C/C++ source patch.
